narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -2.43 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.07795-0.07920 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 0.07969; the first objective pays 0.92R at 0.07751.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 0.07795-0.07920
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.07969 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 25/100 — trend broken, flow fading, whales offering
